scope: 111 E10 tasks and 40 authorized paper abstracts
source: blind-source.json derived from authorized local E10 originals

reviewers.input_access: both independently sealed reviewers, all original abstracts, with E9.1 outputs examined after source snapshot

timestamp_note: A/B UTC times describe filesystem last write, distinct from execution start times.

rules.scope: Per-task permitted papers. source_papers lists focal evidence. Comparison and deployment conditions stay explicit.
rules.answerability: Answerable when principal requested constructs, mechanism, defined measure or bound are available. Partial when meaningful source fields exist but a key mechanism or reported metric definition/value is missing. Insufficient for an absent target result or an untested guarantee. Not comparable when no matched task/inputs/protocol support ranking.
rules.evidence: Unicode offsets [start,end) against the original abstract. SHA-256 of UTF-8 substring. Semantically equivalent windows and paraphrases count as agreement.
rules.disagreement: Material means different answerability, incompatible-polarity interpretation, or a substantively different claim/scope that would alter requested coverage or required caveat. Equivalent estimates, specificity and phrasing alone can agree. Several dimensions may overlap.
rules.contradiction: Requires incompatible findings under matching conditions. Within-study trade-offs, outcomes at different time windows or counterexamples to a universal assumption are retained separately.
rules.prediction: A source-entailed background candidate can still be irrelevant to the requested contribution. Missing substantive claims are tracked in field assessments. Field and task decisions on abstention are reviewed separately.
rules.confidence: Heuristic confidence uses the lower of both reviewer scores and a ceiling. Revised labels receive a stricter ceiling. Scores are uncalibrated.

public_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 files with LF line endings. Private inputs use original file bytes.
source_snapshot_encoding: Sorted keys, unescaped Unicode, compact JSON separators, one LF per JSONL record. Remove prediction_assessment, supported_claims, unsupported_claims, refusal_correctness, failure_category to reproduce the phase-one hash.
